comments.text: I just watched the video with headphones, it's majestic! I live near the sea, I'm going to the beach on my motorbike with my phone and headphones to watch the video along with the sound of the sea, the wind in my long hair, and the smell of the sea breeze. The beach is a very special place for me. I need to have this experience to cherish along with so many other equally magical moments I've already had there. I'll be observing the blue of the Atlantic ocean here from Brazil, like Isak's eyes, and feeling everything I should feel. With love, William. ❤❤❤🌊🌊🌊
